authorization: User accepted the proposal to close broad replication as a bounded attempt and design one focused incremental-value experiment, first assessing statistical precision: good. go for it.
historical_work: All original studies/results/archives remain frozen. This is a separately versioned planning analysis, not a rerun of original source/replay/model/account/analysis helpers.
question: Does replacing a non-LLM factor proposal engine with an LLM add economically worthwhile net performance under a common search and portfolio evaluator?
scope: Paper-informed methodological experiment, not reproduction of any original paper.

planning_preview_already_inspected.note: These analytic previews were inspected during design. Full scenario-grid and simulation specifications are fixed here before running them; no new strategy outcomes are available.

classification.rules_out_worthwhile_positive_increment: 99% CI upper bound below +2 pp/year; not proof of zero alpha

primary_endpoint: 12 x mean paired monthly arithmetic net-return difference, same portfolio capital and 10-bp-per-side turnover costs; named net performance increment, not factor alpha.
alpha_endpoint: Risk-adjusted economic alpha requires a separately frozen adequately identified low-dimensional benchmark and precision assessment; 134 factors on 72 months is prohibited.
development_only_inputs: Inspected 2019-2024 EFS US50 aggregate returns and published four-block standard errors. They are variance proxies, not new confirmation observations. Historical model snapshots and original paper replication are not established.

planning_scenarios.normal_reference: Known-standard-error normal reference; optimistic planning approximation, no guarantee of financial validity.
planning_scenarios.four_group_reference: Four independent normal block estimates, df3; conditional noncentral-t power, not empirical power of every dependent return process.
planning_scenarios.simulation_scope: Independent-normal block benchmark and monthly Gaussian/AR(0.3)/t5/volatility-shift stress scenarios, four contiguous blocks of 18 months; planning diagnostics only.

go_no_go.requirement: At 72 evaluation months and baseline noise scale 1, both ruleout at true 0 and positive detection at true +4pp must achieve 80% power against the +2pp boundary under each planning reference. Passing these models alone would not certify external validity or allow spending.
go_no_go.data_gate: A genuinely unused evaluation period, data/universe provenance and model-knowledge contamination assessment must be frozen. Existing inspected history is development-only.
go_no_go.execution_gate: All gates required; no new paid calls, model fitting, backtesting or original scientific helper execution during feasibility. No automatic pivot to an easier primary endpoint.

global_budget_rule: STRICTLY <1000 USD including historical/uncertain charges; frozen runtime and per-study caps remain unchanged.

sources.role: Noncentral-t distribution definition; installed SciPy version recorded separately.
Grouped t inference has dependence and heterogeneity assumptions; not a blanket validity guarantee.
